items.title: England avoid Australia & India in World Cup draw
items.description: England avoid defending champions Australia and world number one-ranked side India in the group-stage draw for the 2027 ICC Cricket World Cup.

items.title: England call up Crane and rest Archer for Pakistan series
items.description: Leg-spinner Mason Crane has the chance to play for England for the first time in eight years after being recalled for the one-day international tri-series in Pakistan.

items.title: Australia call up Maddinson after cancer recovery
items.description: Australia recall Nic Maddinson for the first Test against South Africa after the New South Wales batter recovered from testicular cancer.

items.title: Winning young player award awesome - Baker
items.description: England and Hampshire fast bowler Sonny Baker says winning the young player of the year award at the PCA awards is a "massive honour".

items.title: Overton hopes to make England selectors' job hard
items.description: Somerset all-rounder Craig Overton says he wants to make England selectors' jobs "as hard as possible" by continuing to play well.

items.title: Somerset pair Overton & Luff take top PCA awards
items.description: Somerset pair Craig Overton and Sophie Luff win the top prizes at the Professional Cricketers’ Association awards.

items.title: Gill hits 223 not out as India chase down Windies' record total
items.description: Shubman Gill hits a career-best 223 not out as India sensationally chase down West Indies' 405-7 in the second ODI in Guwahati.

items.title: English players urged to reconsider Afghan T20 tournament
items.description: English cricketers aiming to play in a men's T20 franchise tournament organised by the Afghanistan Cricket Board have been urged to think about their "daughters, sisters or mothers".

items.title: Tumultuous summer ends in success - what next for Stokes?
items.description: After concluding the county summer with Durham and the end of his England central contract, what is in store for Ben Stokes?

items.title: Australian Hughes among five leaving Sussex
items.description: Sussex announce the departures of five more players at the end of the 2026 season, including Australian batter Daniel Hughes.

items.title: Banton stars as England win Sri Lanka ODI series
items.description: Tom Banton delivers on all of his potential by crashing a brilliant first international century as England wrap up their summer with an ODI series win over Sri Lanka.

items.title: 'Brilliant' Banton scores maiden ODI century for England
items.description: Tom Banton scores a "brilliant" century, his first in an ODI for England, in the third and deciding game of the series against Sri Lanka at The Oval.

items.title: Mendis stars as Sri Lanka beat England to set up series decider
items.description: Kusal Mendis scores 121 to help Sri Lanka to a surprise win against England as they fought back to secure a 16-run victory against England at Headingley to level the three-match series and set up a decider at The Oval on Sunday.

items.title: 'He's changing the narrative' - Mendis' inspires Sri Lanka to victory
items.description: Kusal Mendis produces a captain's innings at Headingley as he scores 121 off 100 balls to put Sri Lanka on course for a big score as they bat first against England in the second One Day International.

items.title: England ease to big victory as Sri Lanka crumble in first ODI
items.description: England maintain their excellent one-day form in a comfortable victory against Sri Lanka, as Will Jacks' stars with bat and ball to help the home side to an 89-run win at Chester-le-Street in the first ODI.

items.title: Barney's Bears - the Warwickshire captain who commands respect

items.title: Leics sign wicketkeeper Blake from Surrey

items.title: Sooryavanshi, 15, among young stars shaping future
items.description: Fifteen-year-old Indian cricket sensation Vaibhav Sooryavanshi has been named on a prestigious list identifying the world's most influential rising stars.

items.title: Buttler out of tri-series while England prepare central contracts

items.title: Kohli & Gill centuries help India past Windies - first ODI scorecard
items.description: Latest scorecard from the first one-day international between India and West Indies in Thiruvananthapuram.

items.description: Surrey sign 21-year-old England all-rounder Freya Kemp on a 'multi-year deal' from the 2027 season onwards.

items.title: Somerset lament lack of ruthlessness in title fight
